status: v9 geometry proposal, calibrated after the user's spacing/rhythm/radius feedback
relationships: Normal, hover, selected and focus keep the same layout cell and measured identity bounds. Cell whitespace is not a file hit target.
The visible file state surface hugs the 44px icon and measured text; it does not fill the 112px layout cell.
A short name produces a 92px visual surface; a two-line name produces 108px. The fixed row step is 128px.
Menu text starts 12px from the outer edge and 16px from its top: 4+8 horizontally and 8+(32-16)/2 vertically, repeating the content inset.
Control 8, file identity 10 and floating surface 12 are role-based radii; only real floating surfaces receive shadows.
Name focus insets are indicator breathing room, not another filled container; they remain stable in all states.
Primary actions receive 4px more horizontal room than secondary actions; section breaks are larger than the repeated row beat.
